author: Dragonfirewolf2
name: RobloxVerify
short: Roblox account verification with Bloxlink + multi-guild role sync.
description: Verify users' Roblox accounts via Bloxlink or profile-code fallback. Supports cross-guild role/nickname sync and Roblox group rank → Discord role bindings. Optionally auto-ranks users on Roblox via rblx-open-cloud (requires ROBLOX_API_KEY env var).
